The Review of Metaphysics
The Review of Metaphysics
is a
peer-reviewed
academic journal
of
philosophy
. It was established by
Paul Weiss
and the first issue was published in September 1947. The journal's primary sponsor is and has been
The Catholic University of America
, but other major universities help sustain it.
[
1
]
The journal publishes articles on
metaphysics
and on the
history of philosophy
. It also has a large
book review
section and lists the abstracts of other English-based philosophy journals. Once a year, it publishes statistics on the philosophy graduate programs in North America. The current
editor-in-chief
is Michael Rohlf (School of Philosophy, The Catholic University of America).
